import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        static final int MAXN = 32;
        int N;
        int[][] a;

        void init(int _N, int _V) {
            N = _N;
            a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = _V;
                }
            }
        }

        void mul(Matrix b) {
            Matrix l = new Matrix();
            Matrix r = new Matrix();
            l.N = N;
            r.N = N;
            l.a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
            r.a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    l.a[i][j] = a[i][j];
                    r.a[i][j] = b.a[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    long t = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                        t += (long) l.a[i][k] * r.a[k][j] % MOD;
                        t %= MOD;
                    }
                    a[i][j] = (int) (t % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] A = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] prefix = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] suffix = new Matrix[64][32];

    static long n;
    static int k;

    static void pre_calc(int i) {
        prefix[i][1] = new Matrix();
        prefix[i][1].N = A[i][0].N;
        prefix[i][1].a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
        for (int x = 0; x < prefix[i][1].N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < prefix[i][1].N; y++) {
                prefix[i][1].a[x][y] = A[i][0].a[x][y];
            }
        }
        
        for (int j = 2; j <= k; ++j) {
            prefix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            prefix[i][j].N = prefix[i][j-1].N;
            prefix[i][j].a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
            for (int x = 0; x < prefix[i][j].N; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < prefix[i][j].N; y++) {
                    prefix[i][j].a[x][y] = prefix[i][j-1].a[x][y];
                }
            }
            prefix[i][j].mul(A[i][j - 1]);
        }
        
        suffix[i][k - 1] = new Matrix();
        suffix[i][k - 1].N = A[i][k-1].N;
        suffix[i][k - 1].a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
        for (int x = 0; x < suffix[i][k-1].N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < suffix[i][k-1].N; y++) {
                suffix[i][k - 1].a[x][y] = A[i][k - 1].a[x][y];
            }
        }
        
        for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
            suffix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            suffix[i][j].N = A[i][j].N;
            suffix[i][j].a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
            for (int x = 0; x < suffix[i][j].N; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < suffix[i][j].N; y++) {
                    suffix[i][j].a[x][y] = A[i][j].a[x][y];
                }
            }
            suffix[i][j].mul(suffix[i][j + 1]);
        }
    }

    static int digsum(long n) {
        int s = 0;
        for (; n != 0; n /= k) {
            s = (s + (int)(n % k)) % k;
        }
        return s;
    }

    static Matrix solve(long n, int m) {
        if (n < k) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix();
            mat.N = A[m][0].N;
            mat.a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
            for (int x = 0; x < mat.N; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < mat.N; y++) {
                    mat.a[x][y] = A[m][0].a[x][y];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
                mat.mul(A[m][i]);
            }
            return mat;
        }
        Matrix mat = solve(n / k, m + 1);
        int x = digsum(n / k);
        for (int i = 0; i < n % k; ++i) {
            mat.mul(A[m][(x + i) % k]);
        }
        return mat;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextLong();
        k = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new Matrix();
                prefix[i][j] = new Matrix();
                suffix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            A[0][i].init(k + 1, 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < k + 1; j++) {
                A[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
                A[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        int m = 1;
        while (Math.pow(k, m) - 1000 <= n) {
            pre_calc(m - 1);
            for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                A[m][x] = new Matrix();
                A[m][x].N = suffix[m - 1][x].N;
                A[m][x].a = new int[Matrix.MAXN][Matrix.MAXN];
                for (int i = 0; i < A[m][x].N; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < A[m][x].N; j++) {
                        A[m][x].a[i][j] = suffix[m - 1][x].a[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (x > 0) {
                    A[m][x].mul(prefix[m - 1][x]);
                }
            }
            m++;
        }
        
        Matrix mat = solve(n, 0);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < k + 1; i++) {
            ans = (ans + mat.a[k][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
